user.title: NX Control
user.description: Enter the console address. You can find it in NX Control → Settings → Set up Home Assistant.

discovery_confirm.title: NX Control
discovery_confirm.description: NX Control was found on {name}. Do you want to add it?

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: On the console, open NX Control → Settings → Set up Home Assistant → Create pairing code, and enter the 6-digit code here.

reconfigure.title: Console address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address of the console (shown in NX Control → Diagnostics → Network).

notifications.title: Phone notifications
notifications.description:
When someone asks for more play time on the console, the phones you choose get a notification with **Approve** and **Deny** buttons. Tapping it opens NX Control.

Each person should sign in to the Home Assistant app with their own user, so the others can be told who answered.

data.notify_results: Tell the others when someone answers

notifications_none.title: Phone notifications
notifications_none.description:
NX Control can send a notification to your phone when someone asks for more play time, with **Approve** and **Deny** buttons.

No phone with the **Home Assistant app** was found. Install it and sign in, then choose your phones in **NX Control → Configure**. You can go on for now.

notifications_test.title: Did the notification arrive?
notifications_test.description: A test notification was sent to the chosen phones. If it did not arrive, check that notifications are allowed for the Home Assistant app on the phone.

sidebar.title: NX Control page
sidebar.description: NX Control adds a page to the sidebar, with the family icon. It shows each player: time left, time played today, the game being played and the reports, and lets you give extra time, block for today and answer time requests from any phone or browser. Every user can see it.

data.sidebar: Show NX Control in the sidebar

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Make sure the console is on and connected to the same network.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and create a new code.

init.title: NX Control settings
init.description: **NX Control page** in the sidebar, and **phones** that get a notification when someone asks for more play time, with Approve and Deny buttons. Phones need the Home Assistant app, and each person should sign in with their own user so the others are told who answered.

data.sidebar: Show NX Control in the sidebar (the card, full screen, for every user)

data.notify_open: Page opened when tapping the notification (empty: the dashboard view with the NX Control card, now {found})

abort.no_phones: No phones found. Install the Home Assistant app on your phone and sign in first.

grant_time.name: Grant time
grant_time.description: Add extra play time for today.

block_profile.name: Block profile
block_profile.description: Block a profile for some minutes, or until the end of the day.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Leave empty to block until the end of the day.
